title: FBI calls Brigham Young its top recruiting source

tellings.quote: Like FBI's talked about how like Brigham Young is like their top source.

plain: Matthew Pines, a researcher speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says the FBI, the US federal police and domestic intelligence agency, has talked about Brigham Young University, a Mormon university in Utah, as its top source of recruits. He raises it as an example of how closely certain communities feed people into US security work.
